_comment: Ready-made model presets for ml/sagemaker/deploy.py (and a reference for infra/terraform/terraform.tfvars). Prices are us-east-1 on-demand SageMaker hosting rates in USD per hour (AWS Price List API, September 2026); check https://aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/pricing/ for your region. 'gated' models need a Hugging Face token (HF_TOKEN) and you must accept the licence on the model's page first.

qwen3-vl-8b.name: Qwen3-VL 8B (FP8)
qwen3-vl-8b.description: Chat, vision and OCR in one model. The default: reads photos, screenshots, scans and charts.

qwen3-vl-4b.name: Qwen3-VL 4B
qwen3-vl-4b.description: Smaller vision model on a cheaper 24 GB GPU. Good for trying things out.

qwen3-8b.name: Qwen3 8B (FP8)
qwen3-8b.description: Strong text-only chat and reasoning model (shows its thinking).

llama-3.1-8b.name: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct
llama-3.1-8b.description: Meta's popular general-purpose model. Gated: needs a Hugging Face token.

deepseek-r1-distill-qwen-7b.name: DeepSeek-R1 Distill (Qwen 7B)
deepseek-r1-distill-qwen-7b.description: Small reasoning model: thinks step by step before answering.

gemma-3-12b.name: Gemma 3 12B
gemma-3-12b.description: Google's open multimodal model. Gated: needs a Hugging Face token.

qwen3-32b.name: Qwen3 32B (FP8)
qwen3-32b.description: Much stronger text model; still one GPU thanks to FP8 weights.

llama-3.3-70b.name: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct
llama-3.3-70b.description: Large model split across 4 GPUs (tensor parallelism). Gated. Expensive: mind the hourly cost.
